kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أغدودن (form XII)
# أَغْدَوْدِنُ (ʔaḡdawdinu) /ʔaɣ.daw.di.nu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِغْدَوْدَنَ (iḡdawdana)
# أَغْدَوْدِنَ (ʔaḡdawdina) /ʔaɣ.daw.di.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِغْدَوْدَنَ (iḡdawdana)
# أَغْدَوْدِنْ (ʔaḡdawdin) /ʔaɣ.daw.din/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِغْدَوْدَنَ (iḡdawdana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
